hooks.name: Run Unit Tests on Python Save
hooks.description: Runs the matching service unit tests after Kiro saves Python application code.

action.command: python -c "import re,subprocess,sys; p=r'''{{filePath}}'''; m=re.search(r'services[\\/](?P<svc>[^\\/]+)[\\/]app[\\/]', p); sys.exit(subprocess.call([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','services/'+m.group('svc')+'/tests/unit','-q','--tb=short']) if m else 0)"
